description: Thirty spread-out golden orbs fired from a gate behind Gilgamesh. Each orb is corrected toward the enemy only at launch, then follows a fixed path; the wide impact spread leaves some shots intentionally missing. Each orb detonates in a 3-block radius and tears through breakable terrain.
description_zh: 从吉尔伽美什身后金色空间门中分散齐射三十发光球，仅在发射时将方向修正至敌人，之后沿固定轨迹飞行；落点宽幅分散，有意让部分光球打空以营造气氛。每发命中后在3格半径内爆炸，并破坏可破坏地形。
